weakest_scene.repair_goal: Replace the column with a picture made of the subject. For example, a heap of 100 dead circuit boards or phones where only 1 glows gold and gets pulled back into a 'recycled' tray, while 99 ore carts roll out of a freshly dug mine beside it. The 1-in-100 should be countable and read without a label. Give Data an action: he digs the one gold chip out of the heap and holds it up next to the mine. Every label should be in full-contrast ink and clear of the column edge.
